name: File and path check
summary: File type risk and Windows path problems
author: friday-core
description: Checks a file name or a Windows path before you trust or use it. It holds 2 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. File type check: Says what a file name or extension is and whether opening it can run code on Windows (exe, msi, bat, ps1, js, lnk and more), rates the risk, and catches the double-extension disguise such as invoice.pdf.exe. Windows path check: Checks one or more Windows paths for the problems that break installs and file tools: forbidden characters, reserved device names (CON, NUL, COM1), trailing dots or spaces, names over 255 characters, paths near the 260-character limit, protected folders (Program Files, Windows) and cloud-synced folders. Converts between C:\ and /mnt/c/ forms and suggests a fixed name. Text only: it never touches the disk.
